info.name: List condition sets <Badge intent="info" minimal outlined>OAuth Scope: condition_sets:read</Badge>

params.name: publicationId
params.description: The prefixed ID of the publication object

params.name: limit
params.description: A limit on the number of objects to be returned. The limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 10.

params.name: cursor
params.description: **Cursor-based pagination (recommended)**: Use this opaque cursor token to fetch the next page of results. When provided, pagination will use cursor-based method which is more efficient and consistent than offset-based pagination.

params.name: page
params.description: **Offset-based pagination (deprecated)**: Page number for offset-based pagination. Please migrate to cursor-based pagination using the `cursor` parameter. If not specified, results 1-10 from page 1 will be returned.

params.name: purpose
params.description: Filter condition sets by purpose. When not specified, all active condition sets are returned.

items.docs: Retrieve all active condition sets for a publication. Condition sets define reusable audience segments for targeting content to specific subscribers. Use the `purpose` parameter to filter by a specific use case.

info.name: Get condition set <Badge intent="info" minimal outlined>OAuth Scope: condition_sets:read</Badge>

params.name: publicationId
params.description: The prefixed ID of the publication object

params.name: conditionSetId
params.description: The UUID of the condition set object

params.name: expand[]
params.description:
Optionally expand the response to include additional data.
`stats` - Calculates and returns the active subscriber count for this condition set synchronously.

items.docs: Retrieve a single active dynamic content condition set for a publication. Use `expand[]=stats` to calculate and return the active subscriber count synchronously.
